ARC-001-RGPD-v1.0.title: GDPR Compliance Assessment — UK→EU Road Information Sharing

controlFields.Scope: Proposed sharing of road network information with EU/EEA recipients (DATEX II and discretionary datasets)
controlFields.Distribution: Data Protection Officer, CISO, Legal Counsel, Open Data Lead, EU Liaison
controlFields.Lead Supervisory Authority (EU): Not applicable — National Highways has no EU establishment. Each EU recipient's national DPA has jurisdiction over the processing in its territory. (UK: ICO remains UK-side regulator under UK GDPR)
controlFields.Data Controller: Determines purposes and means of processing
controlFields.Data Processor: Processes on behalf of a controller
controlFields.Joint Controller: Jointly determines purposes and means with another entity
controlFields.Data minimisation: Only aggregated/non-personal data is in the EU-share scope. Raw ANPR and CCTV excluded by design
controlFields.Purpose limitation: DSA with each EU recipient must bind them to declared purposes (traffic management, road safety statistics, EU ITS Directive compliance) — **contractual gap until DSAs signed**
controlFields.Storage limitation: ANPR 24h / CCTV 31d retention in source system; EU recipients' retention governed by their RoPA — require contractual minimum standard
controlFields.Pseudonymisation: ANPR plates SHA-256 hashed with salt; hash deleted at 24h. Re-identification risk if salt compromised — addressed by hardware security module (HSM) per NFR-SEC-004
controlFields.Privacy-friendly defaults: Public API default is aggregated/anonymised; personal-data endpoints require authentication + purpose declaration
controlFields.Data protection integrated in design: Architecture Principle #12 (Data Minimization), #11 (Data Sovereignty); data model enforces PII classification

ARC-001-ADR-003-v1.0.title: ADR-003: Adopt Event Streaming Platform for Real-Time IoT Data Ingestion

controlFields.Distribution: Architecture Review Board, Programme Board, Data Domain Owners, Infrastructure Teams
controlFields.R-008: Skills shortage for new technology adoption
controlFields.R-015: Data loss during ingestion under peak load
controlFields.Option 1: Do Nothing: Fundamentally incompatible with 9 of 10 decision-driving requirements. 15-minute batch delays cannot meet real-time journey planning (BR-001), public API (BR-003), or event-driven architecture (Principle #13). Included as baseline per Green Book methodology only.
controlFields.Option 3: Self-Managed Kafka: Rejected due to significant operational overhead (3-4 Kafka SRE FTE), 3-4 month time-to-production (risks BR-003 12-month API delivery), manual DR configuration (unacceptable for CNI), and £800K higher 3-year TCO. Superior raw performance (< 10ms latency) is unnecessary when < 2 second is the requirement.
controlFields.Option 4: Managed Kafka: Strong contender but rejected due to 15-20% higher cost than native cloud streaming, dual vendor dependency (Confluent + Azure), less native Azure integration (separate monitoring, identity), and the Kafka wire protocol portability advantage provides limited practical value given ADR-001's Azure commitment.
controlFields.Kafka ecosystem compatibility limitation: Some Kafka Connect connectors may not work with Event Hubs Kafka endpoint
controlFields.Encryption at rest: Azure Storage Service Encryption (AES-256) with customer-managed keys in Azure Key Vault
controlFields.Encryption in transit: TLS 1.3 enforced for all producer and consumer connections
controlFields.Identity & Access: Azure Active Directory with managed identities for service-to-service authentication
controlFields.Access Control: RBAC per Event Hub namespace; domain teams have access only to their namespace
controlFields.Private Endpoints: Azure Private Link for Event Hubs; no public internet exposure for producer/consumer connections
controlFields.Audit Logging: Azure Monitor diagnostic logs for all producer, consumer, and management operations
controlFields.Data Classification: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE events (ANPR, CCTV metadata) isolated to separate Event Hub with enhanced access controls
controlFields.Key Rotation: Automated 90-day key rotation via Azure Key Vault; SAS token rotation for legacy producers
controlFields.Network Isolation: Event Hubs deployed in private subnet with NSG rules; IP filtering for sensor gateway ingress
controlFields.AMQP: Advanced Message Queuing Protocol -- open standard messaging protocol used by Azure Event Hubs
controlFields.Avro: Apache Avro -- compact binary serialization format with schema evolution support
controlFields.CAD: Computer Aided Dispatch -- emergency services call handling and dispatch system
controlFields.CAV: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles -- vehicles with connectivity and self-driving capabilities
controlFields.CEP: Complex Event Processing -- real-time pattern detection across multiple event streams
controlFields.CKU: Confluent Kafka Unit -- Confluent Cloud capacity unit for managed Kafka
controlFields.CNI: Critical National Infrastructure -- assets essential for functioning of society
controlFields.DR: Disaster Recovery -- process of restoring systems after a major failure
controlFields.ETL: Extract, Transform, Load -- batch data processing pattern
controlFields.Event Hubs: Azure Event Hubs -- Microsoft's fully managed event streaming service
controlFields.Geo-replication: Automatic data replication between geographic regions for disaster recovery
controlFields.IoT: Internet of Things -- network of connected sensors and devices
controlFields.ISR: In-Sync Replica -- Kafka term for replicas that are fully caught up with the leader
controlFields.Kafka: Apache Kafka -- open source distributed event streaming platform
controlFields.ksqlDB: Confluent's streaming SQL engine for real-time data processing on Kafka
controlFields.MirrorMaker 2: Apache Kafka tool for cross-cluster and cross-region data replication
controlFields.MTTR: Mean Time To Recovery -- average time to restore service after a failure
controlFields.Schema Registry: Service that manages and enforces schemas for event data contracts
controlFields.SRE: Site Reliability Engineering -- discipline focused on system reliability and operations
controlFields.TLS: Transport Layer Security -- cryptographic protocol for secure communication
controlFields.TCO: Total Cost of Ownership -- complete cost of a solution over its lifecycle
controlFields.TU: Throughput Unit -- Azure Event Hubs capacity unit (1 TU = 1MB/s ingress, 2MB/s egress)
controlFields.V2X: Vehicle-to-Everything -- communication between vehicles and infrastructure, other vehicles, pedestrians
controlFields.WGS84: World Geodetic System 1984 -- standard coordinate reference system for GPS

ARC-001-WDOC-v1.0.title: Wardley Doctrine Assessment: National Highways Data Architecture Modernization

controlFields.Distribution: Programme Team, Architecture Team, Leadership
controlFields.Purpose: Modernize National Highways' data architecture from legacy Oracle to cloud-native data mesh, enabling real-time journey planning for 45 million daily road users on England's 4,300-mile strategic road network. The £45M programme must deliver £15M annual savings, 99.95% availability, and an Open Data API within 12 months.
controlFields.Landscape: The Wardley Map (ARC-001-WARD-001) reveals 35 components: 2 in Genesis (Driver Journey Planning, Incident Detection AI), 12 in Custom (data mesh, ANPR, incident management), 14 in Product (API management, streaming, databases), and 7 in Commodity (Azure cloud infrastructure). Significant inertia exists in legacy Oracle (7 databases, 500TB, 45 Oracle DBAs). The critical path runs through custom-built components that require specialist skills (data mesh architects, privacy engineers).
controlFields.Climate: Intense regulatory pressure: GDS Service Standard, TCoP, NCSC Cloud Security Principles, UK GDPR, ICO oversight. Political pressure for 12-month delivery (ministerial commitment). CNI classification elevates security requirements. £60B asset base creates accountability pressure from Treasury and NAO. Market evolution is rapid in event streaming (commoditizing) and AI/ML (maturing), creating build-vs-buy timing sensitivity.
controlFields.Leadership: CDTO as executive sponsor with weekly programme reviews. Monthly steering committee includes ministerial representation. Decision-making is centralized through approval gates (CISO for security, DPO for privacy, GDS for service standard, Treasury for spending). Risk appetite is low — the DfT Permanent Secretary is personally accountable to Parliament. This creates a tension between the federated data mesh governance model and the centralized oversight culture.

ARC-001-WGAM-001-v1.0.title: Wardley Gameplay Analysis: National Highways Data Architecture Modernization

controlFields.Distribution: Programme Team, Architecture Team, Executive Sponsors
controlFields.Map Title: National Highways Data Architecture — Current State & Procurement Strategy
controlFields.Key Components: Driver Journey Planning (Genesis, 0.22), Data Mesh Implementation (Custom, 0.38), ANPR Journey Time Calculation (Custom, 0.35), Event Streaming Platform (Product, 0.72 → evolving to 0.88), Cloud Hosting Azure UK (Commodity, 0.95)
controlFields.Open Approaches + Education: Education grows the developer market that Open Approaches then accelerates. Developers must understand the API value (Education) before open publication drives adoption (Open Approaches).
controlFields.Open Approaches + Tower and Moat: Openness attracts ecosystem participants; ecosystem depth creates the moat. The more third-party apps consume NH data, the more valuable and irreplaceable the platform becomes. Open Approaches is the growth engine; Tower and Moat is the retention engine.
controlFields.Open Approaches + Co-operation: Co-operation with local authorities (DATEX II data exchange) enriches the open data platform with local road coverage. NH strategic + local road data is more valuable than either alone.
controlFields.Experimentation + Managing Inertia: Experiments generate evidence that breaks inertia. A successful AI pilot on M25 J15-J16 overcomes operator scepticism. A successful Traffic Domain data product pilot overcomes data warehouse mindset. Evidence from experimentation is the weapon against change resistance.
controlFields.Industrial Policy + Open Approaches: Government mandates (GDS open data, TCoP share/reuse) provide institutional cover for Open Approaches. The ministerial commitment creates urgency. Industrial policy removes internal blockers that might resist openness.
controlFields.Tesla: First Mover + Tower and Moat + Education
controlFields.AWS: ILC + Land Grab + Tower and Moat
controlFields.Airbnb: N-sided Markets + Market Enablement + Defensive Regulation
